key_insight: Change2Task turns real merged pull requests into executable coding tasks on modern versions of the same repository, creating a scalable source of realistic agent evaluations. It bridges historical software changes with current code states so tasks are both authentic and verifiable.
problem_solved: Coding agents need a steady supply of realistic, executable tasks with a clear software state, specification, tools, and verification. Existing datasets are limited, and manually creating such tasks is expensive and hard to keep up to date.
method: Mine merged pull requests from repository history as the source of candidate tasks.
Align historical change evidence with a healthy modern repository revision to reconstruct a runnable environment.
Verify each task with reliable execution checks so it can be used for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation.
impact: This gives researchers and practitioners a scalable way to evaluate coding agents on realistic software tasks instead of synthetic benchmarks. It can improve trustworthiness, comparability, and long-term maintenance of agent evaluation pipelines.
